title: deepctl help-cache key
description: <entry>.key.json next to a help-cache entry: every input the cached root --help text depends on. Python writes exactly these members; a reader ignores unknown ones (docs/contracts/help-cache.md, rule 0).

format.description: Key format. A reader serves no entry whose format it doesn't know.

version.description: deepctl version that wrote the entry.

prog.description: Program name shown in the usage line.

width.description: min(terminal columns, 80), as Click formatted the text.

executable.description: sys.executable of the Python that wrote the entry.

files.description: Every file or directory read to produce the text, in order. Python writes no key with more than 32.

env.description: Environment variables the text depends on: the value, or null when unset. Python writes no key with more than 64.

text_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the entry file's exact bytes. An entry whose bytes hash differently is a miss.
